title: public/index.html: Questions Board Page
description: Static HTML page with form for asking questions, list display with upvote buttons, and JavaScript that calls the API without innerHTML for XSS safety.

steps.description: Structure: doctype, html lang, head with charset, viewport, title, and CSS styles.
Body: h1 Questions Board, form with input and button, alert paragraph, ul for list.
DOM references: list and problem elements.
Load: fetches /api/questions, maps to li elements with text span and vote button using textContent for safety.
Submit: prevents default, posts to /api/questions, shows error or clears form and reloads.
Startup: load() called on page load.
